title.suggested: Tom Allen among experts predicting the New Orleans fights

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted an Inter Ocean canvass of experts on the September 1892 New Orleans fights. Tom Allen, "ex-heavy-weight champion," picked Sullivan over Corbett in 20 to 30 rounds.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, August 21, 1892, page 29. Dateline Chicago, August 18; canvass by the Chicago Inter Ocean.

facts.fact: Asked by the Inter Ocean to predict the September 1892 New Orleans fights, Allen picked Sullivan to beat Corbett in 20 to 30 rounds, McAuliffe in 25 and Dixon in 10

notes: 855 and 856 are two halves of the same article on the same page (856 is the column 2 continuation, with Allen's betting odds); consider linking or merging them. The current title has no reference to Allen.
